name: Trouble Busters
original_name: トラブル バスターズ
source:
Shuuichi is a new history teacher at Mitarai. The story begins as he is suddenly put in charge of the school's mystery club. The club used to be called the occult research club but was forced to downsize because of numerous scandals. 

Shuuichi feels something is fishy about the club and regrets being called as the advisor as he starts hearing rumors. The vice principal also threatens Shuuichi that if something bad happens, he must take full responsibility! Shuuichi feels extremely uneasy about his career. One day, a student shows up and tells that she has a request to the club...

This is a slapstick comedy of problematic students and a new teacher, who struggles to gets his normal life back. This game is an orthodox adventure game, however, the first and latter parts have completely different stories. In the first half, the player tries to get close to girls. Later on, you choose one of the girl characters and explore a story, which is tailored to each specific character.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20021230193550/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2002/t/trouble_busters/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
translation:
修一是御手洗学校新来的历史老师。故事开始时，他突然被任命为学校神秘社的负责人。这个社团过去叫超自然研究社，却因丑闻不断而被迫缩编。

修一觉得社团有些不对劲，听到各种传闻后后悔自己答应担任顾问。副校长还威胁他说，如果发生什么坏事，他必须承担全部责任！修一对自己的职业生涯极度不安。一天，一名学生出现，告诉他自己有件事想请社团帮忙……

这是一部讲述问题学生与新老师的闹剧喜剧，老师努力想恢复平凡生活。游戏是正统冒险游戏，但前后半段的故事完全不同。前半段玩家尝试接近女孩，之后选择一名女角色，探索为她量身定制的故事。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20021230193550/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2002/t/trouble_busters/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
